resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page and the A-Z list give 85 feet; a social-media post gives 80 feet. The record keeps 25.9 m (85 ft), which two sources support.

The Cook County list and the A-Z list say about six miles inland, northeast of Grand Marais; the 1934 Eliason station description says about 7 miles northeast. The story gives six miles and notes the seven-mile figure.

notes_for_editor: The 1943 move is supported by three sources and is high confidence. Height is disputed (80 vs 85 ft). The Eliason tower has its own FFLA entry and no record in our data; consider adding one. The Star Tribune 'Where towers once stood' article returned HTTP 429 and was not read. The Instagram post is from the @historiccookcounty account and is used only for the 80-ft dissent.
